"And where is the reward, little shell?

arxiv-2112-06090.title: Equidistribution of mass for random processes on finite-volume spaces
arxiv-2112-06090.creator: Timothée Bénard
arxiv-2112-06090.description: Abstract Let G G be a real Lie group, Λ ⊆ G \Lambda\subseteq G a lattice, and X = G / Λ X=G/\Lambda . We fix a probability measure μ \mu on G G and consider the left random walk induced on X X .

arxiv-2210-03650.title: LongtoNotes : OntoNotes with Longer Coreference Chains
arxiv-2210-03650.creator: Kumar Shridhar, Nicholas Monath, Raghuveer Thirukovalluru, Alessandro Stolfo Manzil Zaheer Andrew McCallum Mrinmaya Sachan
arxiv-2210-03650.description: Abstract Ontonotes has served as the most important benchmark for coreference resolution. However, for ease of annotation, several long documents in Ontonotes were split into smaller parts. In this work, we build a corpus of coreference-annotated documents of significantly longer length than what is currently available.

arxiv-2211-05781.title: Demystify Transformers & Convolutions in Modern Image Deep Networks Thanks: Xiaowei Hu, Min Shi, Weiyun Wang, Sitong Wu, Linjie Xing, Wenhai Wang, Yu Qiao, and Jifeng Dai are with the Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory. Min Shi is also with Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wei
arxiv-2211-05781.creator: Xiaowei Hu, Min Shi, Weiyun Wang, Sitong Wu, Linjie Xing, Wenhai Wang, Xizhou Zhu
arxiv-2211-05781.description: Abstract Vision transformers have gained popularity recently, leading to the development of new vision backbones with improved features and consistent performance gains. However, these advancements are not solely attributable to novel feature transformation designs; certain benefits also arise from advanced network-level and block-level architectures.

arxiv-2301-00083.title: Weak semiconvexity estimates for Schrödinger potentials and logarithmic Sobolev inequality for Schrödinger bridges
arxiv-2301-00083.creator: Giovanni Conforti
arxiv-2301-00083.description: Abstract We investigate the quadratic Schrödinger bridge problem, a.k.a. Entropic Optimal Transport problem, and obtain weak semiconvexity and semiconcavity bounds on Schrödinger potentials under mild assumptions on the marginals that are substantially weaker than log-concavity. We deduce from these estimates that Schrödinger bridges satisfy a logarithmic Sobolev inequality on the product space.

arxiv-2310-03981.title: CUPre : Cross-domain Unsupervised Pre-training for Few-Shot Cell Segmentation
arxiv-2310-03981.creator: Weibin Liao, Xuhong Li Qingzhong Wang, Yanwu Xu, Zhaozheng Yin, and Haoyi Xiong✉
arxiv-2310-03981.description: Abstract While pre-training on object detection tasks, such as Common Objects in Contexts (COCO) [ 55 ] , could significantly boost the performance of cell segmentation, it still consumes on massive fine-annotated cell images [ 43 ] with bounding boxes, masks, and cell types for every cell in every image, to fine-tune the pre-trained model.

arxiv-2405-11378.title: Intricate magnetic landscape in antiferromagnetic kagome metal TbTi 3 Bi 4 and interplay with Ln 2-x Ti 6+x Bi 9 ( Ln : Tb ⋯ \cdots Lu) shurikagome metals
arxiv-2405-11378.creator: Brenden R. Ortiz, Heda Zhang, Karolina Górnicka, David S. Parker, German D. Samolyuk, Fazhi Yang, Hu Miao, Qiangsheng Lu, Robert G. Moore, Andrew F. May, Michael A. McGuire
arxiv-2405-11378.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Brenden R. Ortiz, Heda Zhang, Karolina Górnicka, David S. Parker, German D. Samolyuk, Fazhi Yang, Hu Miao, Qiangsheng Lu, Robert G. Moore, Andrew F. May, Michael A. McGuire. Here we present the discovery and characterization of the kagome metal TbTi 3 Bi 4 in tandem with a new series of compounds, the Ln 2-x Ti 6+x Bi 9 ( Ln : Tb–Lu) shurikagome metals.

arxiv-2411-08591.title: Non-affine fractal hypersurfaces: construction and dimensions
arxiv-2411-08591.creator: A. Hossain 1, J. Buescu 2
arxiv-2411-08591.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by A. Hossain 1, J. Buescu 2. This article presents the construction of a non-affine hypersurface on an n n -simplex in ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} . Additionally, fractal dimension of the graph of a non-affine multivariate real-valued fractal function is estimated under certain conditions. Furthermore, the upper bound of the Hausdorff dimension of the invariant probability measure supported on the graph of such fractal function is estimated. Keywords: Iterated function system, Fractal hypersurface, Regular n -simplex, Non-affine fractal hypersurface, Fractal dimension, Invariant probability measure.

arxiv-2508-13804.title: Beyond Human Judgment: A Bayesian Evaluation of LLMs’ Moral Values Understanding
arxiv-2508-13804.creator: Maciej Skorski, Alina Landowska
arxiv-2508-13804.description: Abstract How do large language models understand moral dimensions compared to humans? This first large-scale Bayesian evaluation of market-leading language models provides the answer. In contrast to prior work using deterministic ground truth (majority or inclusion rules), we model annotator disagreements to capture both aleatoric uncertainty (inherent human disagreement) and epistemic uncertainty (model domain sensitivity).

arxiv-2509-10453.title: SSL-AD: Spatiotemporal Self-Supervised Learning for Generalizability and Adaptability Across Alzheimer’s Prediction Tasks and Datasets
arxiv-2509-10453.creator: Emily Kaczmarek, Justin Szeto, Brennan Nichyporuk, Tal Arbel
arxiv-2509-10453.description: Abstract Alzheimer’s disease is a progressive, neurodegenerative disorder that causes memory loss and cognitive decline. While there has been extensive research in applying deep learning models to Alzheimer’s prediction tasks, these models remain limited by lack of available labeled data, poor generalization across datasets, and inflexibility to varying numbers of input scans and time intervals between scans.

pmc-10597002.creator: M Patel, C Fernyhough, Y Loo, M Hillier, H James
pmc-10597002.description: BackgroundPatients with language barriers have worse health outcomes. To promote equitable care, efforts must be made to ensure effective communication with patients, specifically by using professional impartial translation services.AimsTo build upon previous cycles to promote the use of professional impartial translation.MethodsA multi-centre quality improvement project in the Acute Medicine Departments of Bart's Health Trust Hospitals in East London.

pmc-10734010.title: Functionalization of Phosphate and Tellurite Glasses and Spherical Whispering Gallery Mode Microresonators
pmc-10734010.creator: Rafał Nowaczyński, Piotr Paszke, Andrea Csaki, Jarosław Mazuryk, Krzysztof Rożniatowski, Piotr Piotrowski, Dorota Anna Pawlak
pmc-10734010.description: Active whispering gallery mode resonators made as spherical microspheres doped with quantum dots or rare earth ions achieve high quality factors and are excellent candidates for biosensors capable of detecting biomolecules at low concentrations. However, to produce quantum dot-doped microspheres, new low melting temperature glasses are sought, which require surface functionalization and antibody immobilization for biosensor development.

pmc-10801161.title: Applicability of electronic sphygmomanometer use in high-altitude areas according to the AAMI/ESH/ISO collaboration statement
pmc-10801161.creator: Xueting Liu, Runyu Ye, Xin Zhang, Wen Huang, Lirong Sun, Xingwei Huo, Xiaoping Chen
pmc-10801161.description: ObjectiveMercury sphygmomanometer (MS) has now been less and less used and no new devices have been manufactured (according to Minamata convention 2013). The application of the electronic sphygmomanometer (ES) in clinical practice has become increasingly common. However, reliable evidence for the use of the ES in high-altitude areas remains scarce.

pmc-11888813.title: Current Status of Hyperthermic Intraperitoneal Chemotherapy (HIPEC) in Colorectal Cancer (CRC)
pmc-11888813.creator: S.P. Somashekhar, Adwaith Krishna Surendran, Deep Goyal, Saumitra Rawat, Shyam Aggarwal, C. Selvasekar, Purvish M. Parikh
pmc-11888813.description: Accounting for 8.7% of global cancer deaths, colorectal cancer (CRC) is one of the leading causes of cancer-related mortality. Cytoreduction surgery (CRS) combined with hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (HIPEC) is part of a multimodal strategy for managing CRC. HIPEC is designed to target residual microscopic disease using heated chemotherapy.

pmc-12461598.title: Best Case/Worst Case Communication Tool for Trauma Intensive Care Units
pmc-12461598.creator: Melanie L. Fritz, Alexandra H. Hernandez, Amy B. Zelenski, Jenna Nitkowski, Carly Sobol, Kristine Kwekkeboom, Taylor Bradley, Jolene Tsang, Kyle Bushaw, Alex Dudek, Lily Stalter, Margaret L. Schwarze
pmc-12461598.description: This quality improvement study implements a tool supporting prognostic communication in 8 trauma intensive care units and assesses the reach, effectiveness, adoption, implementation, and maintenance outcomes among clinicians. Introduction Millions of older adults sustain traumatic injuries every year in the United States.

pmc-12616877.title: Neutrophil Extracellular Traps Activate Meningeal Fibroblast to Aggravate Subarachnoid Fibrosis in Kaolin‐Induced Hydrocephalus in Rats
pmc-12616877.creator: Chao Ma, Zhou Feng, Binyuan Xiong, Liang Liang, Shengyan Liu, Lingxia Min, Qiang Zhang, Peiwen Guo, Jingyu Chen, Liang Tan, Jingming Hou, Zhi Chen
pmc-12616877.description: Background and ObjectivesSubarachnoid fibrosis is the key pathology of hydrocephalus, but its underlying mechanisms remains poorly understood. In the present study, we aim to verify the hypothesis that neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs), released by neutrophils infiltrated into the subarachnoid space following hemorrhage and infection, might be a crucial culprits in promoting subarachnoid fibrosis in hydrocephalus.

pmc-12743029.title: Occupational radiation exposure of radiologic technologists in Interventional neuroradiology
pmc-12743029.creator: Anna Beckert, Christopher Kloth, Angela Kretschmer, Bernd Schmitz, Johannes Rosskopf
pmc-12743029.description: PurposeWith the rising number of angiographic interventional procedures, occupational radiation exposure is becoming increasingly relevant. As even low doses may contribute to stochastic health effects, enhanced radiological protection measures are warranted. This study aimed to systematically quantify the radiation exposure of radiologic technologists under routine clinical conditions and in an experimental setting.

pmc-12859939.title: Immunogenicity analyses and indirect ELISA application of a chimeric virus-like particle presenting a highly conserved peptide of Akabane virus Gc protein
pmc-12859939.creator: Jingjing Wang, Fang Wei, Ruyang Yu, Dongjie Chen, Shaoqiang Wu
pmc-12859939.description: BackgroundAkabane virus (AKAV) is the causative agent of an economically significant disease in ruminants, manifested notably by outbreaks of abortion and congenital abnormalities. Vaccination stands as the primary defense against this disease. However, the development of safer, more stable, and efficient AKAV vaccines, including epitope-based designs, remains unexplored.
